_Most machine learning never makes it to production. Your job is to make sure ours does. We are looking for an ML Engineer who turns models into reliable, maintained systems that construction companies actually use to make better decisions about their equipment and operations. You will work at the intersection of data science and software engineering, shaping how machine learning gets built, deployed, and improved at Trackunit.

_**What’s in it for you?

**Bring machine learning into everyday use. Turn models and experiments into reliable products that help customers make better decisions about their equipment and operations.

Shape how we build and run ML. Influence the tools, engineering practices, and deployment patterns that take solutions from an initial idea through to production and continuous improvement.

Work on interesting data challenges. Explore how equipment, sensor, and contextual data can support useful predictions and insights for the construction industry.

Build alongside people with different strengths. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and product teams, combining scientific thinking with practical software engineering and customer understanding.

Develop your craft and your career. Join an international environment with knowledge sharing, feedback, and support for your personal and professional development.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• You have MLOps experience taking machine learning solutions into production and maintaining them beyond their initial release.

• You bring strong Python skills and solid software engineering practices, including testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD.

• Databricks expertise is a significant advantage.

• You ideally bring strong hands-on experience building ML workflows in Databricks, tracking experiments and managing models with MLflow, and deploying and monitoring models in production.

• You understand the ML lifecycle, from feature preparation and reproducible training to evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

• You can work with data scientists to assess model performance, recognise issues such as data leakage and drift, and translate experimental code into maintainable systems.

• You have experience with cloud platforms and tools for orchestrating ML workflows and serving predictions. You can make sensible trade-offs between reliability, performance, and cost.

• You enjoy shaping solutions with others, explaining technical choices clearly, and connecting engineering decisions to customer needs.

• Experience training, tuning, and validating machine learning or deep learning models would be a plus.

• Experience with time series, sensor or geospatial data, or distributed processing would be a plus.

You don’t need experience with every tool or data type listed. If you bring strong engineering skills and enjoy making machine learning useful in practice, we’d like to hear from you.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

DHL Global Forwarding (Denmark) is looking for an experienced Air Freight Pricing Specialist

At DHL Global Forwarding, competitive air freight solutions are about more than offering the lowest price. They are about understanding the market, making commercially sound decisions and finding the right balance between cost, capacity, service quality and customer expectations.

As our new Air Freight Pricing Specialist, you will play a central role in supporting the commercial performance of our air freight product. You will be responsible for developing competitive pricing solutions, supporting tenders and ensuring that our pricing decisions reflect both market conditions and business objectives.

Working closely with airlines, customers and colleagues across Sales, Operations and our international network, you will translate market insights and commercial requirements into pricing solutions that strengthen our competitiveness.

This is a role for someone who understands the dynamics of international air freight, enjoys working with commercial data and negotiations, and takes ownership of delivering accurate and competitive solutions – often within tight deadlines.

You will become part of our Air Freight pricing organization, where market knowledge, commercial judgement and collaboration are essential to success.

Your key responsibilities in the role will be to:

• prepare and deliver competitive air freight quotations, RFQs and tenders, ensuring accurate pricing, timely submissions and alignment with customer requirements.

• support the implementation of our air freight pricing strategy, balancing commercial objectives, profitability and company guidelines.

• negotiate competitive rates and service conditions with airlines and other suppliers, considering cost, capacity, service quality and transit time requirements.

• build and maintain strong relationships with airline partners, customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring effective collaboration on commercial opportunities and high-priority tenders.

• monitor air freight market developments, capacity, rates and trade lane opportunities, and analyze airline performance to support informed pricing decisions.

• maintain accurate tariffs, pricing databases and supporting tools, while identifying opportunities to improve pricing processes, efficiency and competitiveness.

• share knowledge and provide guidance to colleagues on complex pricing matters, contributing to continuous improvement and professional development within the team.

We are looking for someone, who:

• combines a strong operational understanding with the ability to see opportunities for improvement and development.

• enjoys leading change and understands that successful implementation requires both clear direction and involvement of the people affected.

• works in a structured and analytical manner, using data and operational insights to support decisions.

• takes ownership of challenges and follows improvement initiatives through to completion.

• can balance operational efficiency, quality, compliance and customer expectations.

• communicates clearly and confidently with stakeholders at different organizational levels.

• can influence and create alignment across teams and functions, even without direct managerial authority.

• enjoys developing colleagues, sharing knowledge and building a culture of continuous improvement.

• is comfortable working in an international organization where local priorities and global standards must work together.

We expect you to have:

• have more than 4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably within air freight forwarding, pricing or airline-related commercial activities.

• have a solid understanding of air freight products, market dynamics and commercial pricing principles.

• have experience working with quotations, RFQs, tenders or commercial negotiations.

• be comfortable analysing pricing information, market data and commercial performance.

• have strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with pricing tools or databases.

• have experience collaborating with airlines, suppliers or other commercial stakeholders.

• hold a Bachelor's degree or have equivalent relevant experience and qualifications.

• be fluent in English, both verbally and in writing. Danish language skills are considered an advantage.

And from us, you can expect:

• a specialist role with direct influence on the commercial competitiveness of our air freight product.

• the opportunity to work with international airline partners and global freight forwarding networks.

• a position in a global organization with extensive professional and personal development opportunities.

• close collaboration with experienced colleagues across Sales, Operations and our international organization.

• a working environment where commercial judgement, collaboration and responsibility are valued.

• being part of THE logistics company for the world.

• pension, health insurance, internal development opportunities and more.

Workplace: DHL Global Forwarding, Hedegaardsvej 88, 2300 Copenhagen S – and as part of the job, you will have some traveling, mostly domestically, but as well internationally.

Working hours: The position is a full-time position

The compensation package:

The base salary is determined by your qualifications and competencies. The position is graded and sit within a predefined payband. Besides the base salary you will have – just to mentioned a few of the benefits - a pension scheme, bonus scheme, 25+5 vacation days per year, and a “Fritvalgskonto” (a “saving account” equal to 10% of your annual salary) paid out in December.

How to apply:

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and as we recruit as soon as the right person is found, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Your application should include your CV and a short description of why you see yourself as a strong match for the role.

If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to Head of Growth Michael Schønning at michael.schonning@dhl.com.

We are looking very much forward to hearing from you!

About the company: DHL Global Forwarding is part of Deutsche Post DHL Group, which consists of five divisions that together employ more than 585.000 people across the globe.

Regardless of location and position, the goal is to maintain the position as the logistics company for the world, and therefore, digitalization, sustainability, leadership, diversity and inclusion is a top priority.

In DHL Global Forwarding Denmark, 200+ people are employed and working from one of our three locations, Kastrup, Aalborg or Vejle. All locations have ocean and air freight and support customers within almost all industries.

Our culture is familiar, our values are Respect and Results, and we are all working towards our vision of “Connecting people, Improving lives”.

If you are interested in learning more about DHL please visit our website www.dhl.dk

jobs.occupation: Forensics Solutions Activation Leader Associate Director
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Location: European hubs (flexible)

Level: Associate Director

Employment type: Permanent, full time

**Role Summary

**We are seeking a commercially minded, market-facing leader to drive the growth and adoption of our portfolio of digitally enabled and AI-enhanced forensic solutions across Europe, with extension into APAC. Our Integrity & Compliance solution is a flagship offering within this portfolio and will feature prominently — but the role spans the wider set of technology-led forensic solutions we need to commercialise.

The central purpose of the role is market activation: helping country and regional Forensics teams move from traditional, manual delivery to modern, technology-led ways of serving clients — and, in doing so, unlocking new revenue. The successful candidate will partner with local leaders to build go-to-market approaches, shape and win opportunities, and accelerate the adoption of new solutions in their markets.

This is a commercial and go-to-market role first. The successful candidate does not need deep, hands-on technical expertise, but must be fluent enough in forensic technology and AI to speak about it credibly, translate capability into client value, and help territories both commercialise and deliver these solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Strategic Market Development

**

• Drive the execution of the European (and, by extension, APAC) growth strategy for our digitally enabled forensic solutions, aligned to global priorities and regional targets.

• Identify market opportunities, emerging regulatory trends and client needs to expand the solution portfolio across countries.

• Partner with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to build market plans, go-to-market approaches and priority pursuits.

• Develop practical playbooks, propositions, case studies and market materials that help countries accelerate revenue and client penetration.

• Track market performance and pipeline to focus effort where growth potential is greatest.

**Driving Adoption & Commercial Enablement

**

• Lead the shift from manual, traditional delivery to technology-led delivery — acting as the catalyst for behaviour change across local teams.

• Equip country leaders and teams to confidently position, sell and scale technology-enabled forensic solutions.

• Act as a trusted commercial advisor to country leaders establishing or expanding these offerings.

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and leading practices across Europe and APAC to build commercial momentum and consistency.

• Help local leaders understand — at the right level — how technology, analytics and AI translate into client value and competitive advantage.

**Client Engagement & Commercial Leadership

**

• Support strategic pursuits and priority opportunities across the forensic solution portfolio, including Integrity & Compliance, investigations, monitoring, forensic data analytics, eDiscovery, third-party and regulatory risk, and AI-enabled solutions.

• Help countries shape complex proposals and solution approaches for priority opportunities.

• Identify cross-border opportunities and bring global capability to bear to win and deliver client work.

• Drive pipeline development and revenue growth across priority markets.

**Market Presence & Thought Leadership

**

• Represent the firm at client forums, industry events and internal leadership meetings.

• Champion the firm's perspective on technology-enabled, AI-enhanced forensic solutions.

• Develop market insights and commercial materials that support business development and portfolio growth.

• Deliver compelling presentations and demos for country leaders, practitioners and clients.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Build strong relationships with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to advance growth objectives.

• Influence senior stakeholders across geographies to back adoption and growth initiatives.

• Foster cross-region collaboration to share resources, opportunities and leading practices.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Demonstrated success in commercialising services and driving revenue growth within a professional services environment — ideally new or technology-enabled offerings.

• Proven ability to drive change and adoption across distributed, matrixed teams.

• Strong client network and market-facing relationships that can be leveraged.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and executive-level communication skills.

• Sufficient fluency in forensic technology and AI to speak credibly and connect capability to client value — deep hands-on technical expertise is not required.

• 10–15 years' experience within Forensics, Compliance, Regulatory Risk, Financial Crime, Investigations or related Forensic & Integrity services.

**Preferred

**

• Experience across European and APAC markets.

• Knowledge of Integrity & Compliance disciplines (ABC, third-party risk, monitoring, investigations, ethics programmes).

• Awareness of advanced analytics and AI applications relevant to forensics and regulatory risk.

• Multilingual capabilities (English plus another major European language).

**Success Metrics

**

• Revenue growth and pipeline expansion across the forensic solution portfolio in Europe and APAC.

• Measurable shift from manual/traditional to technology-led delivery in priority markets measured through adoption of technology.

• Increased capability and participation of country teams in selling and delivering technology-enabled solutions.

• Growth in cross-border and multi-country engagements.

• Market-facing assets and thought leadership that support commercial growth.

**Working Model

**

• Hybrid across European hubs; travel 30–50% for client meetings, country activation and leadership forums.

Reports to [confirm exact global reporting line]; close collaboration with Global, Regional and Country Forensics leadership.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.occupation: Global Assoc Commercial Competitive Intelligence Director
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Global Associate Commercial Competitive Intelligence Director, you will help shape the strategies behind Novo’s projects and future commercial brands in diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease. You will monitor the commercial competitive landscape, competitor strategies and turn what you find into data-driven insights that sharpen decisions at project, product and portfolio level. By elevating and challenging our approach, you will help Novo stay ahead – and strengthen the commercial strategies that bring treatments to people living with diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease.

**What You’ll Bring

**You think independently, set the agenda before you are asked and bring people together across functions to influence decisions. You are comfortable in an expert role and confident managing stakeholders at every level. We are open to candidates at different career stages, so the depth of experience we look for will vary with your background:

• An M.Sc. in Business, Medicine or Life/Pharmaceutical Sciences.

• Relevant experience in similar roles.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical industry is highly preferred.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable intelligence.

• The ability – or a proven track record – to communicate scientific, medical and commercial information clearly to diverse audiences, including senior management.

• An understanding of drug development, commercial strategy and pharmaceutical value chains, with depth matching your seniority.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in social media monitoring.

**What You’ll Do

**You will provide high-quality monitoring and insight generation on the commercial competitive landscape and competitor strategies, helping commercial teams act on what is happening in the market today.

• Deliver high-quality, data-driven insights on the commercial competitive landscape across diabetes, obesity, Liver and Cardiovascular disease.

• Drive strong commercial competitive insights that improve decision-making at project, product and portfolio level.

• Lead assessments of key intelligence topics of strategic interest, working with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Act as a strategic partner to Commercial teams, making sure real-time insights are translated into competitive counter-strategies.

• Contribute to building and developing the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function.

• Encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Commercial Competitive Intelligence team, which monitors, assesses and activates commercial competitive intelligence within core strategic areas in diabetes, obesity, Liver and CVD. The team is part of Strategic Insights, where you will work alongside colleagues in Customer & Consumer Insights and in Data, Analytics & AI Strategy.

Strategic Insights sits within Product & Portfolio Strategy, which drives commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across all therapy areas. The area acts as a connector and compass – guiding the portfolio for sustained competitiveness upstream and maximising its potential through strong commercial strategies and competitive launches downstream.

Your closest partners will be Commercial teams, and you will engage with stakeholders across the value chain. Bringing these perspectives together – and creating clarity on what competitor moves mean for Novo – is how your insights will turn into action.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will take on an expert role with real influence: your insights will feed directly into decisions on projects, products and the wider portfolio. You will be trusted to set the agenda, make your voice heard and challenge established thinking when the evidence calls for it.

You will also help develop the Commercial Competitive Intelligence function itself, giving you the chance to shape how the work is done, not just deliver it. Working across commercial, medical and data-focused colleagues, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job. Because we are open to different career stages, your responsibilities and salary will be tailored to your experience.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn competitive intelligence into decisions that keep Novo ahead in diabetes and obesity, apply for the Global Assoc Competitive Intelligence Director role by 29 October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• 
You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• 
You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• 
You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• 
You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• 
You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• 
Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• 
A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Product Compliance Manager to join Veo's newly established Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team.

As Veo continues to grow, we navigate a broad range of regulatory requirements across our products and business, from certifications, product safety, and environmental regulation to market access and broader compliance obligations.

In this role, you will focus on product-related regulatory compliance and certifications, while also working across Veo's broader compliance agenda. You will work closely with colleagues across Hardware, Product Development, Production, Procurement and other parts of the business to understand applicable requirements and help translate them into practical processes and solutions.

You will join a small GRC team with a broad mandate and significant exposure across Veo. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding regulation, technology, and business.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Coordinate Veo's product certification and market-access activities across relevant markets, working closely with Hardware, Production and other internal stakeholders.

• Monitor and assess new and changing regulatory requirements relevant to Veo and help determine their practical implications for our products and business.

• Develop and maintain a structured overview of regulatory and certification requirements applicable to Veo's products throughout their lifecycle.

• Drive and coordinate implementation of regulatory and compliance requirements across relevant business functions, ensuring clear ownership, appropriate documentation and timely follow-up.

• Work with regulatory frameworks relevant to Veo's products, including areas such as product safety, batteries, electrical and electronic equipment, environmental requirements, waste and recycling obligations and related product compliance requirements.

• Coordinate with external certification bodies, laboratories, consultants and other specialists where required.

• Maintain and develop compliance documentation, certification records, technical files, declarations and other evidence required to demonstrate compliance.

• Support the assessment of regulatory and compliance implications when Veo enters new markets, introduces new products or makes material changes to existing products.

• Support Veo's broader compliance activities, including policies, procedures, monitoring, due diligence, risk assessments and training.

• Support customer, auditor and other stakeholder requests relating to compliance and certifications.

• Contribute to the continued development of Veo's broader GRC framework and take part in cross-functional compliance projects as required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• Relevant higher education in engineering, technology, law, business, quality/compliance, or another relevant discipline.

• Relevant professional experience within product compliance, regulatory compliance, certification, quality/regulatory affairs or a similar area, preferably from an international company.

• Experience working with regulatory requirements affecting hardware or electronic products is an advantage.

• Experience with one or more areas such as product safety, product certifications, battery regulation, electrical/electronic equipment regulation, environmental product requirements, waste/recycling regulation or similar regulatory regimes.

• Experience coordinating certification processes, testing, technical documentation, declarations or interactions with certification bodies and laboratories is highly relevant.

• Broader compliance experience, for example within sanctions and export controls, third-party due diligence, anti-bribery and corruption or other corporate compliance areas, is an advantage.

• An ability to understand complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical requirements for technical, operational and commercial teams.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating initiatives across different functions and areas of expertise.

• A structured approach to documentation, monitoring and follow-up, combined with the ability to identify and prioritize material compliance risks.

About Linkfire and where we're heading

Linkfire is the marketing platform the music industry uses to connect fans with the music they love. Our next chapter is about helping artists and their teams really know their fans: who they are, what they care about and how to reach them again. We have a packed roadmap heading into 2027, and it's vital that our customers know about the features we're shipping and see the value in them. That's where you come in.

The role

We're back in growth mode and rebuilding marketing, starting with this role. For now you'll operate as our solo in-house marketer, owning product marketing end to end. You'll report to the Director of Product and work closely with our product managers and commercial team.

The first job is clear: get our existing customers using what we've built, and turn their results into stories that help us sell to others.

If webinars or other new channels make sense, you can lead building them.

This isn't a performance marketing role. We expect to add performance and acquisition marketing when the time is right, as a dedicated function with its own resources, not an extra job on top of this one.

As marketing grows, there's a path to building and leading a team covering brand and identity, website, socials, and the onboarding journeys that convert new customers and keep existing ones.

What you will do

• Hands-on experience with customer messaging tools such as Intercom, including segmentation and automation.

• Clear, persuasive writing in English. You can turn a technical feature into something a busy label marketer or artist manager will actually read.

• An eye for design and comfort creating content yourself. You’ll produce visuals and short videos for launches, working with our designer on the bigger pieces.

• Comfort with data. You set up tracking, read the results and change what you do because of them.

• You already use AI in your daily work and have opinions about where it helps and where it gets in the way.

Nice to have

• Knowledge of the music industry, or another creator or entertainment market.

• An interest in how fan and customer data gets captured and used, whether from working with CRM or CDP tools or just being curious about it.

• Experience working asynchronously in a distributed team.

Location

We’d love you to be based in Copenhagen or elsewhere in Denmark. We’re a distributed company and plenty of our colleagues are fully remote, but we have a cosy office on Rentemestervej where many of us visit a couple of days a week. This helps us stay in sync and we’d like it if you can join us.

English is our working language, and all our customer comms are in English too, so you don’t need to speak Danish.

How to apply

Along with your CV, tell us about a feature launch you ran: what you did, and what happened to adoption afterwards. A couple of paragraphs is plenty.

Why join Linkfire

• Real ownership from day one. How we launch and talk to customers is yours to shape.

jobs.description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• 
You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• 
You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• 
You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• 
You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• 
You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• 
Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• 
The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Architect, build, and scale AI systems that hold up in production

Take ownership of how AI is architected, built, and scaled across our products. You will design the agentic systems at the core of our pension and advisory platforms, with a focus on reliable and responsible AI.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help lead our newly established AI team, working on our Life product for pension companies. The team is focused on the practical and responsible use of AI and is still in its early stages, so as a senior member you will play a defining role in setting the technical foundation, design patterns, and ways of working that the rest of the team builds on.

You will work closely with the AI Team Lead and Chief Architect, who own the overall architecture, helping shape the design within that direction. You will also be part of an agile team with a flat structure, where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning are central to the culture.

This role is primarily about designing and building agentic and LLM systems end to end, with a meaningful share of your time spent owning how we evaluate them and prove they hold up. It suits someone with 5+ years of relevant experience who wants to move beyond implementation into designing AI systems, and who enjoys raising the bar for the engineers around them.

Why this matters

This is core infrastructure, not edge tooling. Our Life product runs policy and capital administration for some of Europe’s largest pension providers, including PensionDanmark and APG, and is on track to support more than 8 million members and over €800bn in retirement assets.

The AI you design must meet that bar: fast and innovative, but also accurate, secure, and reliable enough for systems that people depend on for their financial security in retirement. Building it well and being able to prove it works, are two sides of the same job.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the AI team, you will help shape how we build with Large Language Models and agentic systems across our products, contributing to high‑level design decisions, turning ambiguous business problems into robust system designs, and ensuring high‑quality coding standards and design. You will be hands‑on, with a real say in the architecture, standards, and technical judgement that guide the team.

In practice, you will:

Help shape the technical direction

• Contribute to the AI tech stack across our products: help define the high‑level system design, reference architectures, and design patterns the team builds on.

• Help shape AI strategy: identify where AI can create genuine value, frame the trade‑offs, and feed into a coherent, prioritised technical roadmap that fits our wider platform.

• Inform major architectural decisions: model and framework selection, build‑versus‑buy, and how AI components fit into our existing Java platform, integrate with surrounding systems, scale, and stay maintainable over time.

• Reason about trade‑offs in the open: weigh latency, cost, accuracy, security, and reliability, and explain and defend those choices to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Architect and build (hands‑on)

• Design LLM systems end to end: from retrieval, agent orchestration, and data pipelines through to deployment and monitoring.

• Design and build agentic systems: single‑ and multi‑agent, covering orchestration, tool use, action groups, knowledge‑base integrations, and patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation, and result aggregation for complex, reliable production workflows.

• Engineer RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data.

• Drive quality through design: prompt strategy, system prompts, and memory systems that produce hallucination‑resistant outputs with strong relevance and faithfulness.

• Make cost‑aware architectural choices: balancing latency, cost, and quality across model selection and orchestration patterns so what we ship is sustainable at scale.

• Set the standards for prompt strategy, RAG, orchestration, and cost management that the wider team adopts.

Evaluate and prove

• Build evaluation frameworks: eval sets, golden datasets, and LLM‑as‑judge pipelines, with offline regression suites wired into CI and online evaluation on production traces.

• Evaluate the whole agent, not just the answer: task success, trajectory and tool‑use correctness, and RAG faithfulness and grounding, so you know whether failures come from retrieval, reasoning, or generation.

• Measure what gates shipping: relevance, faithfulness, latency, cost, and reliability across repeated runs, turned into quality gates the team ships against.

Collaborate and grow the team

• Collaborate and mentor: work with the AI Team Lead, Chief Architect, senior developers, and product teams to translate business needs into working, well‑tested solutions, and support more junior engineers as the team grows.

What we’re looking for

You bring a strong technical foundation, hands‑on depth with modern AI tooling, and the judgement to design systems that hold up in the real world. You don’t need deep expertise in every area below, but we do expect real depth in agentic systems and AI architecture, backed by a solid grasp of how to evaluate what you build.

Required

• A master’s degree in computer science or a similar field, preferably with an AI focus.

• 5+ years building software, with significant hands‑on work applying Large Language Models.

• Strong proficiency in a statically typed, object‑oriented language, Java or C# (we build in Java). Python is welcome for demos, evaluation tooling, and experiments, but it is not our production language.

• Deep experience designing, building, and operating agent‑based systems, with hands‑on use of one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agents, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).

• A track record of designing and building AI systems, including how the components fit together, scale, and are maintained over time.

• Solid, practical experience with prompt strategy, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and the cost considerations of LLM usage and model selection.

• Working knowledge of LLM and agent evaluation: eval sets, LLM‑as‑judge, and the metrics that distinguish a good system from a confident‑but‑wrong one (faithfulness, relevance, task success, latency, and cost).

• Experience designing AI or backend systems that fit into a larger production platform, collaborating with senior engineers and architects to align on a shared technical direction.

• Strong communication skills to explain and defend architectural trade‑offs to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Experience building automated evaluation pipelines or CI gates for AI systems.

• Familiarity with observability and tracing tooling for LLM applications (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Braintrust).

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation, automation, and red teaming.

• Broader machine learning experience.

• Hands‑on experience building and integrating MCP servers.

• Experience working in regulated or high‑reliability domains such as finance, insurance, or healthcare.

Who you are

You are a confident, hands‑on engineer who takes ownership of complex and sometimes undefined problems, and who is just as comfortable designing a system as proving it holds up. You think in systems, balance pragmatism with quality, and care about building things that work in production rather than just in a demo. You lift the people around you, stay open to feedback, and bring strong technical judgement of your own. You are curious, persistent, and result‑oriented.

jobs.occupation: Program Manager - HR Shared Services Center, Global HR
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven Program Manager to lead the establishment of HR Shared Services Center (SSC), a key pillar in our HR transformation journey, driving the design, planning, and implementation of this strategic initiative.

In this role, you will establish a program organization and lead multiple workstreams and coordinate timelines, resources, budgets, stakeholders and risks to ensure the successful implementation of our HR Shared Services Center. You know which priorities to recommend, what to communicate to the HR organization and when to involve other corporate functions if necessary. Furthermore, you will bring together people, processes, technology and organisational change to establish an efficient, scalable and high-quality HR service delivery model.

**Welcome to Global HR

**You will join Demant's Global HR organization and work closely with HR Core Deliveries, business units, Shared Services C operations teams and stakeholders across the global organization.

Our approximately 400 HR professionals work globally to attract, develop and empower the people who drive Demant's continued success. As a global leader in hearing healthcare and hearing aid technology, Demant is on an ambitious transformation journey. In this role, you will help shape how HR services are delivered and experienced across the organization.

**Lead the HR Shared Services Center Transition

**As Program Manager for HR SSC, you will manage the day-to-day implementation of the SSC transition, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring alignment throughout the implementation. Working closely with senior leadership, HR Core Deliveries, business units, SSC operations and project leads, you will maintain momentum, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure clear communication and decision-making. You will also help ensure business continuity and successful adoption of the new HR service delivery model.

In this role, you will:

• Lead program delivery, including plans, milestones, budgets, KPIs, governance and coordination of multiple workstreams.

• Be responsible for the business case

• Track project progress against established milestones, KPIs and business case

• Drive stakeholder alignment and communication, facilitating collaboration across senior leadership, HR, business units and SSC operations.

• Manage resources, risks and dependencies, ensuring appropriate allocation of capacity and timely escalation and resolution of issues.

• Oversee transition and change activities, supporting adoption and maintaining business continuity throughout implementation.

• Ensure effective reporting and project governance, including dashboards, steering committee materials, decisions, actions and lessons learned.

• Ensure quality and compliance, including appropriate acceptance criteria and consideration of country-specific legal and regulatory requirements.

**What You Bring

**You hold a bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Human Resources, Project Management, Organizational Development or a related field.

You have significant project management/program management experience, including large-scale transformation or Shared Services Center establishment and transition initiatives. You have successfully managed complex, multi-workstream projects involving substantial budgets and diverse stakeholders, preferably within HR operations or HR transformation.

You have great knowledge of project management methodologies and tools. PMP certification or equivalent is an advantage, as is experience with platforms such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana or similar.

Experience with HR systems and processes is important, with knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow or similar solutions considered an advantage. You are also highly proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable working with project dashboards, reporting and data. As a colleague, you are structured, collaborative and solution oriented. You create clarity and momentum in complex environments and can lead cross-functional teams without direct authority. You communicate assertively with both project teams and senior executives and are comfortable working across cultures and geographies.

Furthermore, you are analytical and pragmatic, with good problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. You combine project management discipline with business acumen and an understanding of HR operations and organisational dynamics.

Finally, you have a good compliance mindset and understand the importance of balancing country-specific requirements with global standards and objectives.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to take a central role in a significant HR transformation and help shape the future delivery of HR services across Demant.

You will work with experienced colleagues and senior stakeholders across the global organization and have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on how HR services are delivered, scaled and continuously improved.

If you enjoy complex transformations, international collaboration and turning ambitious plans into successful execution, we would like to hear from you.

**Come and join us

**Send your CV before application deadline November 2.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Vice President, Global HR Core Deliveries, Maj Øhle Storri, via email mjsr_@demant.com

_We are curious to meet you.

**Recruitment Process Information

**We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 9th, 10th, and 11th of November. You can expect the final round interviews to be held on the 17th, and 18th of November.

Senior Consultant

**SENIOR CONSULTANT CAREER OPPORTUNITY

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced professional from the pharmaceutical industry, passionate about improving business processes and driving impactful change? Devote Consulting is expanding its team and is looking for a Senior Consultant with expertise in clinical operations, data, and GxP systems (e.g., CTMS, eTMF, EDC, QMS, RIMS, LIMS).

****Are We Looking for You?

• You thrive in the fast-paced life of consulting and enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas.

• You take ownership of your tasks, delivering high-quality work that makes a difference for patients.

• You have experience working with agile delivery methods and understand how to optimize business processes using data efficiently.

• You are excited about improving processes and implementing systems in Life Science R&D, including creating the required compliance documentation.

• You’ll excel in our high-achieving culture, with ample opportunities for both personal and professional growth.

****What You’ll Do

****As a Senior Consultant at Devote Consulting, your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting projects: Deliver changes in the life sciences industry focused on processes, data, and systems within R&D, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs.

• Business process optimization: (Re)design and improve business workflows for greater efficiency.

• Stakeholder management: Lead project planning, change management, and delivery of compliance documentation.

• Driving project success: Ensure project progress and maintain high-quality standards for deliverables.

**Your Qualifications

**We’re looking for individuals with the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree in business administration, IT, life sciences or equivalent

• 5+ years of experience as a consultant, business analyst, project manager, or equivalent role in regulated industries such as Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for making an impact

• Experience in creating compliance and validation documentation

• Fluent in English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Expertise in Clinical R&D systems (CTMS, eTMF, eSource, RBM, EDC, QMS, LIMS, etc.) and/or medical devices

****What We Offer

****At Devote Consulting, we offer a position where you can take responsibility, influence outcomes, and make a difference in your everyday work. You’ll lead one or more projects as a specialist, business analyst, or project manager, collaborating with clients to drive meaningful change in the pharmaceutical industry.

****Ready to Join Us?

****We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to a recruitment process that ensures equal opportunities for all applicants. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!
